task.instruction: Find a hotel in Ohio From December 20th to December 23th for 3 adults and 2 rooms.

final_answer:
I ran the search on Booking.com for **Ohio, United States, Dec 20–23, 2026 (3 nights), 3 adults, 2 rooms** — 2,832 properties match. Since you asked for a hotel (not a vacation rental), here are the strongest hotel picks, all priced for the full 3-night stay for the whole group:

**Best value + top rated**
- **Embassy Suites by Hilton Akron Canton Airport** (North Canton) — 9.0 "Wonderful" (207 reviews), 2× King Studio suites, breakfast included, free cancellation, no prepayment. **US$704** + US$109 taxes/fees.
- **Tru By Hilton Sandusky, Oh** (Sandusky) — 8.8 "Excellent" (387 reviews), 2× Queen Room with Two Queen Beds, free cancellation, pay at property. **US$544** + US$75 taxes/fees — the cheapest solid hotel option.

**Highest rated downtown locations**
- **Hyatt Regency Columbus** (Downtown Columbus) — 9.1 "Wonderful" (429 reviews), location 9.5, 2× King Rooms, free cancellation, pay at property. **US$900** + US$162 taxes/fees.
- **Hyatt Place Columbus/OSU** (Columbus) — 9.1 "Wonderful" (660 reviews), 2× King Room with Sofa Bed, breakfast included, free cancellation. **US$940** + US$169 taxes/fees.
- **Hyatt Regency Cincinnati** (Downtown Cincinnati) — 8.5 "Very Good" (697 reviews), 2× Queen Rooms, free cancellation, pay at property. **US$1,074** + US$207 taxes/fees.

**Mid-range alternatives**
- **Comfort Suites Columbus Airport** — 7.3 "Good", 2× Queen Rooms with Two Queen Beds, breakfast included. **US$615** + US$111 taxes/fees.
- **Holiday Inn Columbus Dwtn-Capitol Square by IHG** — 7.6 "Good", 2× Standard King Rooms, free cancellation. **US$694** + US$125 taxes/fees.
- **Cherry Valley Hotel** (Newark) — 8.2 "Very Good", 2× King Room with Sofabed, free cancellation. **US$805** + US$118 taxes/fees.

If budget matters most, **Tru by Hilton Sandusky** is the pick; if you want the best-reviewed central base, **Hyatt Regency Columbus** or **Hyatt Place Columbus/OSU** are the standouts. Tell me which one you'd like and I can open it and check the exact room/rate details or hold a reservation.

judge.rationale: The agent searched Booking.com for Ohio, Dec 20–23, 2026, 3 adults, 2 rooms and provided supported hotel options with prices and details.
